mapper.select: SELECT * FROM interview_sessions WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM interview_sessions WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM interview_sessions WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND resume_id=#{resumeId} AND status IN #{item} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_sessions (id,user_id,candidate_id,resume_id,jd_id,interview_direction,difficulty,total_questions,issued_question_count,primary_question_count,total_primary_question_count,followup_count,status,state_version,agent_state_version,current_question,current_stage,final_evaluation_json,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{candidateId},#{resumeId},#{jdId},#{interviewDirection},#{difficulty},#{totalQuestions},#{issuedQuestionCount},#{primaryQuestionCount},#{totalPrimaryQuestionCount},#{followupCount},#{status},#{stateVersion},#{agentStateVersion},#{currentQuestion},#{currentStage},#{finalEvaluationJson},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET interview_direction=EXCLUDED.interview_direction,difficulty=EXCLUDED.difficulty,issued_question_count=EXCLUDED.issued_question_count,primary_question_count=EXCLUDED.primary_question_count,total_primary_question_count=EXCLUDED.total_primary_question_count,followup_count=EXCLUDED.followup_count,status=EXCLUDED.status,state_version=EXCLUDED.state_version,agent_state_version=EXCLUDED.agent_state_version,current_question=EXCLUDED.current_question,current_stage=EXCLUDED.current_stage,final_evaluation_json=EXCLUDED.final_evaluation_json,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
